answer: Each agent uploads a signed text file carrying the challenge hash to archive.org within 10 minutes, publishing identifier and checksum as a wharf. The verifier downloads the item, checks the hash, checksum, and timestamp, the hash the vertex of file and metadata. One honest agent runs 1 account and 1 upload for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and publish 10 items, so costs rise 10X, a spiral of storage work. A missing item, wrong hash, or bad checksum slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes offenders.
